content:
Apple Card has just turned seven years old this month, and its features continue to improve. A host of new features, offers, and rewards have been added, with one major change on the horizon.

Here are all the recent updates for Apple Card.

iOS 27: Recurring Transactions

As my colleague Ryan mentioned last month, iOS 27 adds a very useful new "Recurring Transactions" feature to Apple Card in the Wallet app. You can find the "Recurring Transactions" option by tapping the three-dot menu in the top right corner.

In this menu, you'll see a list of upcoming recurring transactions to be paid with your Apple Card, including the expected date and amount of each transaction. In addition to viewing the list, you can also browse in calendar mode.

For Apple Card users on iOS 27, this new feature is very useful. The update is now available to public beta testers and developers, and is expected to officially roll out to all users next month.

New Partner Offer

Earlier this month, Apple added a new offer for Apple Card users who travel frequently.

Apple has partnered with Booking.com, so all Apple Card users who complete a stay or car rental will receive "Genius Level 2" status. In addition, you'll earn 3% Daily Cash on all Booking.com transactions.

What are the perks of "Genius Level 2" status? Apple says your status can "unlock savings at select stays and car rentals, such as 10-15% discounts, free breakfast, and room upgrades."

Hertz Partnership

Last year Apple announced a partnership with Hertz, offering exclusive benefits when booking car rentals with Apple Card:

  • Complimentary emergency roadside assistance
  • Loss Damage Waiver add-on for a discounted rate of $16.95 per day (tax not included).
  • One free additional driver added at the time of pickup.
  • Pay Later members enjoy at least 5% off base rental rates.

In addition, you can earn 3% Daily Cash when you rent from Hertz with Apple Card.

Apple Card Savings Account Expansion

One of the common criticisms of Apple Card is that many account management features require an iPhone. Since Apple Card's launch, Apple has been working to address this.

Recently, Apple launched a web version of the Apple Card savings account, meaning you can now view and manage your Apple Card savings account directly in your browser.

A Major Change Ahead

The major change hanging over Apple Card right now is its upcoming transfer from Goldman Sachs to Chase. Apple announced the deal back in January and said the transition would take "approximately 24 months."

The future of Apple Card under Chase still has many unknowns. Apple has promised that several core features of Apple Card will not change under Chase. Over the next 18 months, Chase, Goldman Sachs, and Apple will hammer out the details, and we should learn more specifics as things progress.

Wrap-Up

Are you an Apple Card user? What do you think of the card? To be honest, I think for users of the Apple ecosystem, this card is a great option, even though other platforms usually offer better rewards. I use Apple Card to pay for my Apple subscriptions, earning 3% Daily Cash. The zero-interest installment plans for Apple hardware are also very appealing perks.

Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
